# DropSpace v0.2.0-preview.2

This is an experimental Preview hotfix for DropSpace's new **smart file-drag wake** architecture. It is not a replacement for v0.1.0 Stable for important work.

Official website: https://airanluo-dot.github.io/DropSpace/

## Smart drag recognition fix

- Fixes a Preview.1 threading defect where Explorer/Desktop source inspection ran on an asynchronous thread without initializing COM on that actual thread. UI Automation therefore commonly rejected every candidate before the Island could appear.
- Explorer file icons may expose an image or text element under the pointer. Recognition now walks a bounded UI Automation ancestor chain to find the enclosing ListItem/DataItem instead of requiring the deepest element itself to be a file item.
- The existing safety gates remain: the pointer must begin in a known Explorer/Desktop file view, cross the Windows drag threshold, and the temporary visible OLE target must finally receive a real `CF_HDROP` data object.
- Hidden idle still owns no top-edge hit-test window. Classic top-edge mode remains an explicit compatibility fallback for unsupported third-party and virtual-file sources.

## Update and website reliability

- Fixes in-app checks that failed when the anonymous GitHub REST API was unavailable or rate-limited on a shared network.
- Adds the versioned official release contract at `/api/v1/releases.json`. The app tries the official GitHub Pages endpoint, then GitHub REST.
- The website refreshes Stable downloads and Changelog entries from the same contract at runtime, with complete build-time metadata as an offline-safe fallback.
- Website metadata cannot redirect DropSpace to an arbitrary executable: every release and asset must still match the official GitHub repository, tag, and asset name. Existing manifest, size, SHA-256, deployment-mode, and unsigned-install safeguards remain unchanged.

## Preview limitations

- Real Explorer/Desktop UI Automation provider behavior, false-positive rate, mixed-DPI placement, and Windows Drop Tray coexistence still require Windows 11 desktop testing.
- Some third-party apps and virtual-file providers may not expose enough public evidence for Smart mode. Use **Traditional top-edge zone (compatibility mode)** when needed.
- This Preview is unsigned. Unattended automatic installation remains disabled; verified updates require explicit user action.
- Preview.1's broken metadata path cannot repair its own installed binary. Preview.1 users must download and install Preview.2 manually once; releases after Preview.2 can use the repaired in-app source chain.

Stable-channel users will not receive this Preview. Select the Preview channel only to test experimental builds.
